jobDescription: The HR software company implements its payroll and absence products for mid-sized employers. The Implementation Consultant configures the products to each customer's policies, runs the customer workshops that capture the policies, loads and reconciles the customer's employee data, trains the customer's HR administrators, and documents each implementation's boundaries. Go-live approval stays with the implementation manager. The role requires running workshops with customer HR teams who disagree among themselves. Reports to the implementation manager; works with the customers' HR teams, the data migration team and the support team.
requirements: Configures the payroll and absence products to customer policies under the configuration standard.
Runs customer policy workshops under the workshop method, resolving disagreements within the customer's team into a recorded decision.
Loads and reconciles customer employee data with the data migration team.
Trains the customer's HR administrators, with go-live approval staying with the implementation manager, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each implementation's limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers under the configuration standard.

Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign-off on each workshop record.
Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.
Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go-live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go-live checklist together with which checks were mine.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each implementation in the hand-over pack to the support team.

Work sample: two workshop records with the customers' sign-off, one reconciliation report, one go-live checklist with the manager's approval and one hand-over pack, with the implementation tool references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 1 note: in the workshop exercise, when the two panel members playing the customer disagreed on the overtime policy, the candidate wrote both positions on the board, asked which payroll rule each would produce, showed the two resulting payslips, and recorded the decision the customer then made with the name of the decider.

Reference call with the former implementation manager: confirmed the candidate ran the workshops and the training in the period, that go-live approval stayed with the manager, and confirmed the employment dates.

propositions.text: The candidate configured the payroll and absence products for twenty-three mid-sized employers at an HR software company for three years under the configuration standard, and loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team under a reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the reconciliation report document the configuration and the data work.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the policy workshops under the workshop method with disagreements within customer teams resolved into recorded decisions signed off by the customers, and trained the customers' HR administrators with go-live approval staying with the implementation manager.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the workshop records and the reference call document the workshops, the training and the approval boundary.

propositions.text: In the workshop exercise the candidate wrote both disputed positions on the board, showed the payroll rule and resulting payslip for each, and recorded the customer's decision with the name of the decider.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the workshop requirement, not an impression.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions are documented in the hand-over packs to the support team, but the limitation notes for the two implementations still in progress are not in the materials.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one exercise; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
followUpTargets: Ask for the limitation notes of the two implementations still in progress.
